title: Mixed Ligand Mononuclear Copper(II) Complex as a Promising Anticancer Agent: Interaction Studies with DNA/HSA, Molecular Docking, and In Vitro Cytotoxicity Studies.
authors: Paliwal, Kumudini; Haldar, Paramita; Antharjanam, P K Sudhadevi; Kumar, Manjuri
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜配合物与DNA/HSA的相互作用及抗癌活性，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸体系而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主，仅分子对接辅助，与TF-DNA结合建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: The isolated copper(II) complex [CuL(o-phen)].H(2)O (1) [H(2)L = o-HO-C(6)H(4)C(H)=N-C(6)H(4)-SH-o, o-phen = 1,10-phenanthroline] was structurally characterized using single-crystal X-ray crystallography. 1 in CH(3)CN at liquid nitrogen temperature displayed a characteristic monomeric X-band electron paramagnetic resonance spectrum having a tetragonal character with g ( parallel) = 2.1479 and g ( perpendicular) = 2.0691 and A ( parallel)  approximately  18.0 mT and A ( perpendicular) </= 3.9 mT, respectively. 1 showed a strong binding affinity toward calf thymus DNA as reflected from its intrinsic binding constant (K (b) = 7.88 x 10(5) M(-1)), and its competitive displacement of ethidium bromide suggested an intercalative DNA-binding mode (K (app) = 1.32 x 10(6) M(-1)). This was confirmed from the viscosity study that showed an increase in the viscosity of DNA with an increasing concentration of 1. Complex 1 is highly efficient in promoting oxidative and hydrolytic DNA cleavage (k (obs) = 1.987 h(-1)). 1 showed a strong binding affinity with the carrier protein human serum albumin (HSA) (K (a) = 5.22 x 10(5) M(-1)). A high bimolecular quenching constant k (q) = 2.29 x 10(13) M(-1)s(-1) indicated a static quenching mechanism involved in the fluorescence quenching of HSA by 1. Fluorescence resonance energy transfer theory suggested that the distance (r = 3.52 nm) between 1 and HSA is very close. Molecular docking studies suggested that 1 primarily binds to HSA in subdomain IIA. A protein-ligand interaction profiler was used to visualize hydrophobic, hydrogen bonds, and pi-cation interactions between HSA and 1. A 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide assay using HeLa and MDA-MB-231 cells showed a significant in vitro anticancer activity of 1 (IC(50) 2.63 and 2.68 muM, respectively). Nuclear staining assays suggested apoptotic cell death in HeLa cells treated with 1. The effect of 1 on the cytoskeletal actin filaments visualized using phalloidin staining showed extensive destruction of actin filaments. Flow cytometric analysis indicated that 1 inhibits the growth of HeLa cells through cell cycle arrest in the S phase. Western blot analysis showed upregulation in the expression of apoptotic marker proteins caspase 3, p53, and Bax. These results collectively indicate that 1 induces apoptosis by promoting DNA damage and has a high potential to act as an anticancer agent.
abstract_zh: 分离的铜(II)配合物[CuL(o-phen)].H(2)O (1) [H(2)L = o-HO-C(6)H(4)C(H)=N-C(6)H(4)-SH-o, o-phen = 1,10-菲咯啉]通过单晶X射线晶体学进行了结构表征。1在液氮温度下的CH(3)CN中显示出特征性的单体X波段电子顺磁共振谱，具有四方特征，g(平行) = 2.1479，g(垂直) = 2.0691，A(平行) ≈ 18.0 mT，A(垂直) ≤ 3.9 mT。1对小牛胸腺DNA表现出强结合亲和力，其内在结合常数(K(b) = 7.88 x 10(5) M(-1))，及其对溴化乙锭的竞争性置换表明其具有插入式DNA结合模式(K(app) = 1.32 x 10(6) M(-1))。这通过粘度研究得到证实，该研究显示随着1浓度的增加，DNA粘度增加。配合物1在促进氧化和水解性DNA切割方面高效(k(obs) = 1.987 h(-1))。1与载体蛋白人血清白蛋白(HSA)表现出强结合亲和力(K(a) = 5.22 x 10(5) M(-1))。高双分子猝灭常数k(q) = 2.29 x 10(13) M(-1)s(-1)表明1对HSA的荧光猝灭涉及静态猝灭机制。荧光共振能量转移理论表明1与HSA之间的距离(r = 3.52 nm)非常接近。分子对接研究表明1主要结合在HSA的亚结构域IIA中。使用蛋白质-配体相互作用分析器可视化了HSA与1之间的疏水相互作用、氢键和π-阳离子相互作用。使用HeLa和MDA-MB-231细胞的3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物测定显示1具有显著的体外抗癌活性(IC(50)分别为2.63和2.68 μM)。核染色测定表明用1处理的HeLa细胞发生凋亡性细胞死亡。使用鬼笔环肽染色观察1对细胞骨架肌动蛋白丝的影响显示肌动蛋白丝广泛破坏。流式细胞术分析表明1通过细胞周期阻滞在S期抑制HeLa细胞生长。Western blot分析显示凋亡标志蛋白caspase 3、p53和Bax的表达上调。这些结果共同表明1通过促进DNA损伤诱导凋亡，并具有作为抗癌剂的巨大潜力。
